2026_04_ATL_NO.headline: Bijan Robinson tests a thinned Saints front as New Orleans leans on red-zone answers
2026_04_ATL_NO.paragraph1: Atlanta arrives in New Orleans with Bijan Robinson coming off a huge night in Green Bay and Michael Penix Jr. feeding Drake London downfield, while the Falcons also monitored several defensive starters during the week. The Saints face a sharper personnel concern at linebacker, where injuries threaten the second level against Robinson. Kellen Moore can counter by leaning on Alvin Kamara and a tight-end group featuring Juwan Johnson and Noah Fant that has become a useful red-zone stress point for Atlanta.
2026_04_ATL_NO.model_rationale: Atlanta’s rushing efficiency can stress New Orleans’ depleted second level, while the Saints’ best counter is sustaining drives and turning tight-end matchups into red-zone opportunities.
